How it works

Three simple steps

01

Snap your meal

Open the app, point your camera at your food, and tap the button. That's it — no login needed.

02

AI does the work

Gemini AI analyses your photo in seconds — identifying every ingredient, portion size, and calorie count.

03

It goes in your diary

Your meal is instantly logged in your personal food diary with nutrition info and a beautiful entry.

Features

Everything you need, nothing you don't

Snap your snack

Just point your camera at any meal. No scanning barcodes, no tedious typing.

Instant AI magic

Gemini AI identifies every ingredient, estimates portions, and calculates calories in seconds.

Watch your progress

Beautiful charts show your weekly trends, macros breakdown, and calorie streaks.

Personal food diary

Your food story, day by day. Add notes, moods, and memories to every meal.

Mindful eating

Set daily goals, get gentle nudges, and celebrate every healthy choice you make.

Always-on insights

Smart suggestions based on your eating patterns help you make better choices effortlessly.

Why Snacc Buddy?

Calorie tracking that actually feels good

We built Snacc Buddy because calorie apps felt like homework. We wanted something that felt like writing in a diary — personal, warm, and fun.

  • No manual food database searching
  • Works with any cuisine from any country
  • Handles homemade and restaurant meals
  • Private — your diary stays on your device
  • Completely free to download and use
